description.to:
As an operator, I want a dispatcher claim that fails before enqueue or execution to become safely retryable, so that a durable Procedure continuation cannot remain stranded in DISPATCHING.

Observed behavior: the dispatcher claimed a pending continuation, then its transport raised before enqueue. The Task remained PENDING/DISPATCHING and could not be claimed by the supported local dispatcher.

Feature: Recover failed pre-dispatch claims

Scenario: Transport fails before dispatch
Given a pending Task has been atomically claimed by a dispatcher
And the transport raises before returning an external dispatch identity
When the dispatcher handles the failure
Then the Task is returned to a claimable pending state using a conditional update
And the failed dispatcher identity is cleared
And no second Procedure or Task is created

Scenario: Dispatch may already have occurred
Given a transport returns an external dispatch identity
When a later persistence update fails
Then the dispatcher does not rearm the Task automatically
And duplicate execution is prevented

Out of scope: GraphQL schema or resource changes; bypassing durable continuation checks; changing optimization policy.
